title: Aadhar Card Download | Appointment Book | Update | PVC Order | Etc 2022
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in
2. Login with Aadhaar/VID + OTP
3. Download e-Aadhaar / Order PVC
4. Book appointment or update demographics online
5. Track update status with URN
shortDescription: Aadhaar Card download, update, appointment booking, PVC order – all services on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.
content:
UIDAI MyAadhaar portal provides complete Aadhaar lifecycle services:

  • Download e-Aadhaar (PDF)
  • Order PVC Aadhaar card
  • Update name, address, DOB, mobile, email
  • Book Aadhaar Seva Kendra appointment
  • Check enrolment / update status
  • Lock/unlock biometrics

Never share OTP. Official: uidai.gov.in / myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.
